newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot LPGs steady ahead of inventory data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot LPGs steady ahead of inventory data.

text.p: U.S. spot LPG prices were steady in quiet late trade on Thursday as players waited for weekly government inventory data due out later today.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu spot propane remained between 49.50 cents and 49.75 cents with few deals heard done.
Conway, Kansas, hub material traded for 48.62 cents, about even with morning levels. Buyers, of which there were few, and sellers remained far apart at 48.50/49.00 cents, players said.
Belvieu normal butane, however, roared ahead one cent amid a spate of shortcovering to 52.50/53.00 cents. Conway normal followed, trading a half cent higher at 51.50 cents.

It is still unclear how stocks will appear in the Energy Information Administration report, although one analyst predicts a draw due to propane supplies being moved to secondary storage for winter. Secondary storage is not counted by the EIA.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
